desc: Make the two D41 in-flight submit deadline tests in internal/agent deterministic, test-only, with late-start regression subtests
done_when: Task 1's late-start subtests fail against the old test shape and pass after the change; all eight Acceptance Contract commands pass; every prior assertion and value is kept; only the two declared files change.
scope: IN: internal/agent/inflight_submit_deadline_test.go; the declared acceptance manifest. OUT: production code, other test files, testhelpers, oracle files, skips or budget-only widening.
spec_ref: specs/goals/20261023-architecture-consolidation-decisions.md#D41 — Stabilise two inherited timing-flaky internal/agent tests (run, 2026-10-24)
plan_ref: specs/plans/20261023-architecture-consolidation/20261024-031400-deferred-validation-2-1-correction-plan.md#Task 1: Make the two D41 deadline tests deterministic
validation: env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" TMPDIR=/tmp make lint

env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" TMPDIR=/tmp go test -race -count=20 -run '^(TestExecuteAgentProgressWatchdogStillBlocksDuringHandback|TestExecuteAgentBlocksSubmitStillRunningWhenGraceEnds)$' ./internal/agent/
env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" TMPDIR=/tmp go test -race -count=1 ./internal/agent/
env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" TMPDIR=/tmp go test -race -count=1 ./internal/oracle/a1/persist/...
env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" TMPDIR=/tmp go run ./internal/testhelpers/oracle/cmd/regen -mode check -pkg ./internal/oracle/a1/persist/...
env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" TMPDIR=/tmp ORACLE_VERIFY_TAMPER=1 go test -count=1 -timeout 25m -run '^TestOraclePersistenceTamper$' ./internal/oracle/a1/persist
env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" TMPDIR=/tmp make test
